name: The Village Shoppes
summary: The Village Shoppes is a community shopping center in Canton, Massachusetts, managed by Kimco Realty. This open-air center serves the southern Boston suburbs with convenient retail, dining, and services, maintaining strong customer satisfaction with a 4.3-star rating.
demographics: The Village Shoppes in Canton attracts a diverse suburban demographic primarily consisting of middle to upper-middle income families from the Greater Boston area. The trade area draws heavily from Canton and surrounding communities like Norwood, Stoughton, and Sharon, with shoppers typically ranging from young professionals to established families with household incomes above the Massachusetts median. The center serves as a convenient neighborhood shopping destination for time-pressed suburban residents seeking everyday retail and dining options close to home.
description: The Village Shoppes at Canton is a well-established community shopping center located at 95 Washington Street in Canton, Massachusetts, serving the southern suburbs of Greater Boston. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, this center has become a reliable neighborhood destination for local residents. The property features a convenient open-air layout that provides easy access to a variety of retail stores, dining options, and service providers. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, The Village Shoppes offers flexibility for shoppers throughout the week. The center maintains a strong reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.3-star rating from over 750 Google reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and its role as a valued shopping destination in the Canton area.
